column1: # IT6805 initialisation at probe (fixed part, RD order)
# evidence: T1/S01 (no input), T3/S20 (5 V present); identical up to the 5 V evaluation. Masks and loop rules: S

# op: W write value (mask ff) · M read-modify-write: new = (old & ~mask) | value · D delay, value = ms (RD nominal; RD's real sleeps were longer) · P poll until (reg & mask) == value · R read, value = traced (informative) · X step described in hdmi-it6805.md (§ in note)
# dev: 8-bit I2C address on bus 1 (90 IT6805, e0 IT6805 sub-block). bank: bank in effect (reg 0x0f[2:0]); * = the bank register itself; - = not banked. All numbers hex except D values (decimal ms).

# RD = reference driver. Values are what RD wrote. R rows are informative reads; RD also read most registers before writing them (omitted). RD's repeated selects of an already selected bank are omitted: the bank column gives the bank in effect.
# Bank selects are written as plain writes (RD used read-modify-write of bits 2:0; bits 7:3 of 0x0f always read 0).
# Steps (hdmi-it6805.md §3.2): ID · fixed table · calibration · tristate · factory data + trim · reference clock · EDID · output path · 5 V evaluation.

# Replay check (D): applied to the read values of T1/S01 and T3/S20 and followed by the 5 V-branch tables, these rows reproduce every IT6805 register write of both loads in order, value and bank (bank-select writes compared via the bank column; EDID RAM bytes and X-step writes checked separately).
